opening.argument: The speaker directly urges viewers to buy Litecoin through his Coinbase referral link, telling them to act before it rises. He says prices may not remain this low and gives viewers perhaps a week, a week and a half, or two weeks, while predicting Litecoin could double or triple. The purchase solicitation, referral mechanism, urgency, and large-return projection work together as a promotional appeal. Although the description calls the discussion opinion rather than advice, that disclaimer does not remove the affirmative solicitation.

citations.quote: Go buy Litecoin right now. Stop listening to me talk. Click my little referral link down below for coin base, and go buy some Litecoin before it gets through the roof.
The prices that are low right now, they're never going to be this low probably again. So you've probably got about maybe a week, week and a half, maybe two weeks based off of what I'm hearing.
Before a Litecoin is double or triple of where it's at now. It's coming. It is coming.
I am not a financial advisor so please know anything that is discussed on this channel is merely my opinion and not advice telling you what to do.
